blocks.content: Build and dependency plumbing. Runtime dependency is marked only (for transcript rendering) — everything else is dev tooling. Scripts: dev (vite + electron concurrently), build:main/build:web, typecheck, start, smoke, and dist / dist:dir / dist:win / dist:linux. electron 45 + electron-builder 26 targets mac dmg+zip (arm64, unsigned), nsis (win.icon = dependency-free build/icon.ico), and AppImage, asar-packed with only dist-electron/dist-web shipped; bundled-skills/ ships inside the app and scaffolds into the data root on launch. Cross-platform CI uses the .github/workflows/build.yml matrix and passes `--publish never`, so CI stores artifacts without attempting a GitHub Release upload. scripts/afterPack.js flips the Electron security fuses on each packaged binary and resolves Linux through electron-builder's `executableName`; macOS bundles are re-sealed ad-hoc after fuses are changed. ASAR integrity computation stays disabled (`disableAsarIntegrity`) until the build is code-signed, because builder 26 hashes every *.asar in Resources including exFAT AppleDouble shadows. CI actions are pinned to full commit SHAs.
v3 path fix — the compile layout keeps electron/ + shared/ under one rootDir.
Bumped at each release's final commit.
